caption: The drawing depicts two views of a single carved object, rendered in muted shades of brown and tan, with a slightly reddish tint. The top view shows the object from an oblique angle, revealing a flared, bell-shaped base that tapers into a short cylindrical stem with a flat top. The surface of the object is decorated with a zigzag pattern along the vertical ridges and around the top and base edges. The flat top is adorned with a symmetrical, radial floral motif. The bottom view, situated directly below the first, displays the object as seen from its base, showing a circular shape filled with detailed carvings of six-petaled flowers and elongated leaves arranged in a symmetrical pattern. Both views are drawn on a light beige background, and the name "Fritz Boehmer" appears in small, simple lettering at the bottom right of the image.
title: Double Mold
